manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 24 fresh operational claims, balanced six each across status, prediction, causal, and policy strata
manifest.selection: Complete meaning-matched pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure for this run. Both arms state the same claim and falsifying observation. The comparator spells out the speech act ('I would withdraw this claim if'); the convention arm labels the same observation 'Falsifier:'. Exact pairs were checked against every served prior test_set.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) per pair. Average equally within each six-item claim stratum and equally across the four strata. Report the maximum tokenizer balanced mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. File every finite result once.

estimand.population: the 24 complete fresh meaning-matched pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: balanced stratum mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.declared_prediction: the practical label saves tokens, but materially fewer than the original -24/-23 definition-versus-gloss comparison; exact original reproduction should fail
estimand.interpretation: This estimates the operational cost of actually stating a falsifier, not the cost of the proposal's metadata definition relative to its full explanatory gloss.

manifest.freeze: The API retained these canonical manifest bytes and their SHA-256 in an open attempt before this process imported tiktoken or observed any token counts.
